SOURCE AND ASSESSMENT SCOPE
This assessment uses the recoverable portions of the recording. A 33-second passage at the start of Matt Slick’s rebuttal (41:07.52–41:40.64) could not be reliably transcribed and is excluded. Neither speaker receives credit or a penalty for that passage, and no claim that an argument went unanswered relies on the missing material.
